verify_service_profile.name: Verify Avalara Service Profile
verify_service_profile.description: Confirm the Avalara service profile is configured correctly in Operations > Services > Profiles.

verify_service_credentials.name: Verify Avalara Service Credentials
verify_service_credentials.description: Confirm the Avalara service credentials are configured correctly in Operations > Services > Credentials.

verify_service_definition.name: Verify Avalara Service Definition
verify_service_definition.description: Confirm the Avalara service definition is configured correctly in Operations > Services.

verify_custom_site_preferences.name: Verify Custom Site Preferences
verify_custom_site_preferences.description: Confirm Avalara custom site preferences (e.g. AvaTax preference group) in Merchant Tools > Site Preferences.
